embeds.title: Day 6 shipped — Tier 1 is fully playable end-to-end
embeds.description: First real shift loads from `data/shifts/qc_tier1_001.yaml`, Zod-parsed at boot. 5 incidents spawn into the live queue at scheduled game-min. Dispatch from the palette, watch them resolve on real OSM roads. At T+12.0 the win/loss modal lands with an S/A/B/C/D grade and a per-incident table. ~48 real seconds at 1× speed.

fields.name: Build
fields.value: tsc clean · 58/58 tests · vite 17s · 531 KB gz

fields.name: Phase 1 progress
fields.value: Day 0–5 ✅ · **Day 6 ✅** · Day 7 next (bug bash + first Producer touchpoint)

fields.name: First shift on disk
fields.value: `data/shifts/qc_tier1_001.yaml` — 12 game-min, 5 incidents (false alarm → diabetic → MVA → cardiac → tree on road). Designed as a relaxed introduction at 1× speed. CI validator (`npm run validate:shifts`) green.

fields.name: Shift loader · src/sim/shift.ts
fields.value: `parseShift(yaml)` → Zod-validated `Shift`. `spawnDueIncidents()` is pure: returns the incidents whose `spawn_time_game_min` has been reached and aren't yet in the live queue. Address resolution is case-insensitive trimmed-street match against the baked Address Map.

fields.name: Tick loop integration
fields.value: After Phase-3 FSM and before `setState`, the loop advances the spawn timeline (incidents flow into the queue) and checks end-of-shift. One commit per frame. `incidents_spawned: Set<string>` makes the spawn step idempotent.

fields.name: Outcome scoring
fields.value: `computeOutcome(shift, liveIncidents)` classifies each incident as `resolved_in_window` (1.0), `resolved_late` (0.5), `missed` (0.0), or `cancelled` (0.0). Score → grade: **S** ≥0.95, **A** ≥0.85, **B** ≥0.70, **C** ≥0.50, **D** <0.50.

fields.name: ShiftSummary modal
fields.value: Lands when `shift_status === "complete"`. Big grade chip (emerald S/A · amber B/C · crimson D) + four-stat block + per-incident table (Spawn / Due / Resolved / Outcome). Esc or click-outside dismisses; world stays paused.

fields.name: Tests
fields.value: **58/58 pass.** Day 6 added 13: Zod parser (shipped YAML, default severity, reject empty incidents); spawn-timeline (no-op before due, fires at due, idempotent on already-spawned, address-miss FAIL, case-insensitive match); outcome (S=all on-time, D=nothing resolved, C=all late→0.5, late_by math).

fields.name: Day 7 next
fields.value: Bug bash + Producer touchpoint #1. Watch a full shift play through, hunt the soft edges (selection desync after spawn, route-glitches on tight turns, summary grade math against pathological ties), capture a 60-sec recording for review.
